// REQ: LANG-2751 LANG-2752 LANG-2753 LANG-2754
module Demo {
  /* Types */
  type record Greeting { charstring text, integer count }
  type port GreetPort message { inout Greeting }
  type component Tester { port GreetPort p; timer t := 5.0 }
  testcase tc_greet() runs on Tester {
    p.send(Greeting: { text := "Hello", count := 31 });
    t.start;
    alt { [] p.receive { setverdict(pass) } [] t.timeout { setverdict(fail) } }
  }
}
